title: Actor template input
description: Shared knobs. Real Actors add their own fields and keep headless.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Run Chromium headless. Default true, including on the Apify platform.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Stop when the next result, proxy, or CAPTCHA event would pass this amount. Default 5, maximum 100. Later rows are saved and are not billed.

maxProxyCostUsd.title: Max proxy spend (USD)
maxProxyCostUsd.description: Cap on proxy events alone. Default 0.50, clamped to maxSpendUsd. The first request stays direct. A proxy retry happens only after a block, and only when this cap and maxSpendUsd both still have room. 0 skips the proxy retry.

allowCaptcha.title: Allow CAPTCHA solving
allowCaptcha.description: Default false. When false, a challenge after the proxy retry pushes a blocked row and exits without a solve charge. When true, a solve is attempted only if that proxy retry is still a challenge and maxSpendUsd covers the captcha event. An unconfigured solver pushes blocked and is not billed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy group
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy group used only after a direct request is blocked. Leave Apify Proxy off so the first attempt stays direct. Empty groups use datacenter. Residential is used only when this field selects it.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Optional group names, such as DATACENTER or RESIDENTIAL. Used after a block when proxyConfiguration has no apifyProxyGroups. The first request stays direct.
